scope: Compact current evidence router. Stable requirements and original qualification limits belong to the contract catalog; routine review and actual artifact execution belong to the referenced evidence files.

previous_review.limits: Preserve the original certified range and original runtime/test coverage; this review does not rescan older history.

source_review_summary.limit: Only this fixed target is reviewed. Runtime, delivery and installed acceptance remain separate.

limits: Source review, source-test execution, exact-artifact qualification, PR delivery and installed acceptance are separate.

Qualification covers macOS arm64 private stdio and named retained consumers with synthetic local providers and disposable homes. No desktop startup, installation, live-account/provider acceptance, physical audio, release, tag or publication.

Only the three exact official worker-permission reload source cases were executed. They supply internal eviction proof; Nextest source helper selection does not prove signed production-artifact execution.

The signed production CLI and helpers were exercised separately by direct compiled Decodex native tests and repository-owned protocol fixtures. No Nextest CARGO_BIN_EXE substitution is used for those executions.
Official target CI contains successful, failed, cancelled, skipped and incomplete jobs. Unresolved causes remain unknown; no generic upstream test pass is claimed.
Shared MCP enablement retains its official-fix and exact legacy-regression gate. Remote execution, Guardian V3, HumanCommand and deferred product experiments remain outside this qualification.
The steering fixture does not force the internal final-flush barrier. The attached-fork fixture uses an intact managed ancestor copy and does not prove every compressed/corrupt lineage variant.
Original feature-qualification and historical coverage limits remain in retained-contracts.json and their exact public revisions. No new performance, billing, cost or dependency-security audit.

retained_native_consumers.limits: Only the named current plan ran. Original feature qualifications remain in the contract catalog.

direct_protocol_regressions.commands: python3 <exact repository script listed in evidence>

upstream_source_proof.entrypoint: cargo +stable nextest run --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin --cargo-profile release -p codex-core --test all -E <three exact selectors> --test-threads 1
upstream_source_proof.consumer: Retained native subagent permissions during sibling-triggered eviction/reload
upstream_source_proof.missing_proof: Public Decodex fixtures do not force the internal residency eviction; this official source scenario forces eviction and verifies retained permission profiles/grants/network policy.
upstream_source_proof.limits: Source-build internal proof only; Nextest can select source helper outputs. Exact signed production artifact is qualified separately by Decodex native fixtures.

validation.gate: Affected packages: decodex-runtime, decodex-codex and decodex-components, all features/tests. Strict Clippy all targets/features and changed-package nightly formatting also passed.

current_runtime_requalification.limits: Development qualification only. Source review, delivery and installed acceptance remain separate.

current_delivery.status: Prepared for one focused PR; live CI and merge are native observations.

documentation_lifecycle: Use supported OpenWiki page jobs. Current and inherited job status, PR checks and merge observations remain native receipts.

historical_evidence.limits: Git retains replaced evidence. Original claims keep their original source, artifact and coverage limits; this link is not current runtime proof.
